name: Stensia
description: Stensia is Innistrad's darkest province, a mountainous land of jagged peaks and perpetual dusk ruled by ancient vampire bloodlines.

description_citations.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Stensia and Vampires
description_citations.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Stensia and Vampires". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Nov 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

summary.text: Stensia is Innistrad's darkest province, a mountainous land of jagged peaks and perpetual dusk ruled by ancient vampire bloodlines.

citations.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Stensia and Vampires
citations.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Stensia and Vampires". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Nov 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

bio.text: Edgar Markov, an alchemist in Stensia, performed a blood ritual during a famine that created the first vampires of Innistrad.

citations.text: "Sorin's Homecoming". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Jan 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

bio.text: When Avacyn returned, Sigarda and her Host of Herons drove vampires out of Stensia, but after Avacyn's madness and unmaking Sigarda withdrew to Gavony and the vampires reclaimed their fortresses.

citations.text: "Stensia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Stensia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Nahiri's magic tore Markov Manor from its mountain perch, and Sorin and Olivia led the Voldaren vampire army off to battle Nahiri.

citations.text: "Stensia", section "Geography of Stensia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

bio.text: Under Olivia Voldaren's Eternal Night, the vampire houses of Stensia tightened their grip on humans, with her decree demanding a bowl of blood from every resident each night.

citations.text: "Eternal Night", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Episode 1: Tithes and Invitations" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2021.

bio.text: Villagers rose against Stensia's vampires, vowing to reclaim what was taken, and its people rekindled their will to fight at a glimpse of dawn.

citations.text: Stensia Uprising (Innistrad: Crimson Vow Promos, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
Daybreak Combatants (Innistrad: Crimson Vow, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

status.text: The latest story material shows Stensia's villagers rising against the vampires after Olivia's tithe decree.

citations.text: Stensia Uprising (Innistrad: Crimson Vow Promos, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
Daybreak Combatants (Innistrad: Crimson Vow, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The demons plot revenge on Traft for frustrating their plans.
timeline.quote: So, as demons do, they laid a trap and plotted their revenge.

citation.work: The Saint, the Geist, and the Angel
citation.text: "The Saint, the Geist, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Sep 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Traft never enters the Blessed Sleep and becomes a geist haunting the world.
timeline.quote: he never passed into the Blessed Sleep, and instead became a geist to haunt the world.

citation.work: The Saint, the Geist, and the Angel
citation.text: "The Saint, the Geist, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Sep 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: With Avacyn's return, Sigarda and her Host of Herons strive to drive out Stensia's vampires, leaving castles in ruin.
timeline.quote: The angel Sigarda and her Host of Herons strove to drive out the vampires, leaving many castles in ruin.

citation.text: "Stensia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Avacyn's madness and unmaking, Sigarda withdraws to Gavony and the vampires reclaim their fortresses.
timeline.quote: Immune to the angels' madness, Sigarda and her host withdrew to Gavony , and the vampires reclaimed their fortresses

citation.text: "Stensia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri's magic tears Markov Manor from its mountain perch.
timeline.quote: torn from its mountain perch and left floating above Stensia by Nahiri 's magic.

citation.text: "Stensia", section "Geography of Stensia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nadia recalls destroying a nest of devils with her uncle two days earlier.
timeline.quote: She and her uncle—the infamous Master Bey—had destroyed a nest of devils on the border with Stensia two days earlier.

citation.text: "Deathtrap". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Olivia Voldaren invents the Court of the Vampire King/Queen holiday.
timeline.quote: This disturbing three-day holiday was invented by Olivia Voldaren .

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Stensia and Vampires
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Stensia and Vampires". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Nov 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Cosper Lowe begins to realize the disappearances of young women who liked him mean a vampire is infatuated with him.
timeline.quote: It has just started to dawn on Cosper that this means he's the target of a vampire's infatuation.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Stensia and Vampires
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Stensia and Vampires". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Nov 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Kastinne's three children are killed by a demon, and she vows vengeance on all demons.
timeline.quote: A demon killed her three children, and she has vowed to slaughter it and every other demon until her children's souls find rest.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Stensia and Vampires
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Stensia and Vampires". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Nov 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Edgar Markov, an alchemist in Stensia, performs a blood ritual during a famine, creating the first vampires of Innistrad.
timeline.quote: Thousands of years ago, before there were vampires on Innistrad, Edgar Markov was an alchemist in the land that would become Stensia.

citation.text: "Sorin's Homecoming". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Jan 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The demon Shilgengar encourages Edgar's blood experiment, which Edgar wanted to achieve agelessness for himself and Sorin.
timeline.quote: A demon called Shilgengar preyed on Edgar's ambition and whispered secrets that would point the way toward Edgar's blood-feeding experiment.

citation.text: "Sorin's Homecoming". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Jan 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Edgar anoints Sorin with the vampiric state and Sorin vanishes, his planeswalker spark ignited by the trauma.
timeline.quote: The trauma of the transformation had caused Sorin's planeswalker spark to ignite.

citation.text: "Sorin's Homecoming". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Jan 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Vampires of Stensia take up residence among humans and kill cathars as the Church's authority fails.
timeline.quote: the authority of the Avacynian Church is failing here, and fast

citation.text: "The State of the Faith". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Liliana searches Innistrad for Griselbrand, snuffing out devils in Stensia and following gossip in Nephalia to the Skirsdag cult in Thraben.
timeline.quote: Her inquiries got her to a name and a place: the Skirsdag cult and the city of Thraben.

citation.work: The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel
citation.text: "The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Kastinne followed her children's tormentors into the caves below Stensia.
timeline.quote: Kastinne followed the tormentors into the ghastly network of caves below Stensia.

citation.text: Soulcage Fiend (Avacyn Restored, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Avacyn, hearing a mother's panicked prayer, leaves her mountain retreat and flies toward Gavony.
timeline.quote: Avacyn focused on the prayer, on the woman sending it to her, and saw an image of the woman running and sobbing in the middle of a large meadow.

citation.text: "A Gaze Blank and Pitiless" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace rides toward Stensia with a silent guide, complaining about Liliana and about needing her help.
timeline.quote: The jagged mountains of the province called Stensia loomed ahead of them

citation.text: "Unwelcome" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace's guide transforms into a werewolf.
timeline.quote: His guide turned to him, accompanied by the stomach-churning sounds of bones cracking and clothes tearing.

citation.text: "Unwelcome" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: The werewolf kills its horse as Jace flees; howls answer from the woods.
timeline.quote: Behind him, the horse's scream was cut short with a wet crunch.

citation.text: "Unwelcome" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: A pack of werewolves chases Jace toward the manor.
timeline.quote: There were at least three of them bounding after him, hideous amalgamations of human and wolf.

citation.text: "Unwelcome" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace conjures a solid illusory bear that tackles one werewolf.
timeline.quote: A hulking bear made of shining blue light took form behind him

citation.text: "Unwelcome" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace takes control of his guide's mind briefly, making it attack the pack's alpha, so the wolves fight each other.
timeline.quote: At last, the connection was complete. Jace was in control.

citation.text: "Unwelcome" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin and Olivia lead the Voldaren vampire army off to battle Nahiri, not to help the people.
timeline.quote: The vampire army marched off down the hill, swords and pikes and red-hot priest symbols held high

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana walks toward Thraben and raises the dead from cemeteries along the road.
timeline.quote: Corpses crawled up out of the earth.

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana, with a growing horde of zombies, declares she is this world's last hope.
timeline.quote: A dozen more zombies lurched out of the ground, compelled to follow in her wake of necromantic power.

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Katilda warns that the land is sending a warning across Stensia, Nephalia and Innistrad.
timeline.quote: The land is sending a warning.

citation.text: Evolving Wilds (Innistrad: Midnight Hunt, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Weeks after the Harvesttide Massacre, Grigori draws blood from his sleeping mother to meet Olivia Voldaren's tithe decree.
timeline.quote: Grigori presses the knife to his mother's wrist.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Tithes and Invitations" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2021.

timeline.summary: Olivia's decree demands one bowl of blood from every resident each night until the festivities.
timeline.quote: one bowl of blood from each resident, once a night until the festivities

citation.text: "Episode 1: Tithes and Invitations" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2021.

timeline.summary: Bats carry away the bowls of blood and ornate black envelopes, and Grigori chooses not to fight them.
timeline.quote: Two head straight for him, each stopping before the bowls.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Tithes and Invitations" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2021.

timeline.summary: Villagers rise against Stensia's vampires, vowing to reclaim what was taken.
timeline.quote: Tonight, we reclaim what's ours!

citation.text: Stensia Uprising (Innistrad: Crimson Vow Promos, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Stensia's people rekindle their will to fight at a glimpse of dawn.
timeline.quote: After weeks of unending darkness, a glimpse of dawn was all the people of Stensia needed to rekindle their will to fight.

citation.text: Daybreak Combatants (Innistrad: Crimson Vow, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Under endless night the vampire houses of Stensia tighten their grip on humans.
timeline.quote: the vampire houses of Stensia tightened their iron grip on the human population

citation.text: "Eternal Night", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Strefan killed his rival Irska Dusken and scattered the Dusken bloodline.
timeline.quote: Strefan killed his rival Irska Dusken and scattered the remainder of the Dusken bloodline.

citation.text: "Strefan Maurer", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Hladvora lured Strefan back to the Maurer estate via Brandt and attacked him; his fate is unclear.
timeline.quote: Strefan's fate after the battle is unclear.

citation.text: "Strefan Maurer", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Stromkirk vampires choose to concentrate their power in Nephalia instead of joining Stensian vampire politics.
timeline.quote: Unwilling to take part in the political and social machinations of Stensian vampires, those of the Stromkirk line chose to concentrate their power in Nephalia instead.

citation.text: "Stromkirk". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Traft vanquishes evil creatures, especially demons along the Ashmouth, aided by Avacyn's warrior-seraphs.
timeline.quote: he vanquished all manner of evil creatures

citation.text: "Traft", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
